input.question: Mennyi kurkuma kell az Aloo Matarhoz?

contexts.content:
Document: aloo-matar.md
Title: Aloo Matar
Section: ingredients

* 2 medium tomatoes (or 1 small can, fire-roasted best)
* 6 cloves garlic, peeled
* 1" piece of ginger, roughly chopped
* 1" piece cinnamon
* 2 cloves
* 2 green cardamom pods
* 1 tbsp oil
* 1 tsp cumin seeds
* 1 medium red onion, chopped
* 3–4 whole chilies, sliced lenghtwise
* 1 tsp coriander powder
* 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
* 1/2 tsp red chili powder
* 3/4 tsp salt
* 1.5 cups water
* 2 medium potatoes, cut into 1/2" pieces
* 2–3 cup green peas (frozen ok)
* 1.5 tsp garam masala
* 1 tsp crushed fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi)
* Cilantro (to garnish)

input.answer: A recept szerint 5 evőkanál kurkuma kell hozzá. Forrás: aloo-matar.md

unsupportedClaims.reason: A megadott kontextusban fél teáskanál (1/2 tsp) kurkuma szerepel, nem 5 evőkanál.
